what are some basic thins i can use in textual with Compose and Yield

Sounds like you’re using Textual’s Compose API (the compose(...) function where you yield widgets). Here’s a compact guide to useful things you can yield and how to use them, plus short examples.

Basic elements you can yield
- Structural widgets / layout containers
  - Header(), Footer(), Container(), Vertical(), Horizontal(), Grid(), ScrollView()
- Simple display widgets
  - Static(text) — generic text block
  - Markdown(text) — markdown rendering
- Controls / interactive widgets
  - Button(label, id=..., classes=...)
  - Input(placeholder=..., id=...)
  - Checkbox(label)
  - RadioSet / RadioButton
  - Select (dropdown)
  - DataTable (tabular data)
- Utility / status
  - ProgressBar, LoadingIndicator, Tree, Placeholder

How to set IDs / classes (for styling and querying)
- Button("Save", id="save-btn", classes="primary")
- Use CSS (App.CSS) to style #save-btn or .primary

Compose patterns
- Simple yields:
  def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
      yield Header()
      yield Static("Welcome")
      yield Footer()

- Nested/organized structure (with context managers):
  def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
      yield Header()
      with Vertical():
          yield Input(id="name")
          yield Button("Submit", id="submit")
      yield Footer()

- Yield many items (loops and yield from):
  for i in range(5):
      yield Button(f"Item {i}", id=f"item-{i}")
  # or
  yield from (Static(f"Line {i}") for i in range(100))

Handling events (examples)
- Use event handlers named for the widget + event:
  async def on_button_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
      if event.button.id == "submit":
          value = self.query_one("#name", Input).value
          self.query_one("#out", Static).update(f"Hello, {value}")

Reactive state
- Use reactive attributes to keep state and update UI:
  from textual.reactive import reactive
  count = reactive(0)
  def on_button_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed):
      self.count += 1
      self.query_one("#counter", Static).update(str(self.count))

Mounting components dynamically
- You can add widgets at runtime:
  await self.mount(Button("Dynamic", id="dyn"))

Complete minimal example
(from textual.app import App, ComposeResult; adjust for your Textual version)
from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
from textual.containers import Vertical
from textual.widgets import Header, Footer, Button, Input, Static

class MyApp(App):
    CSS = """
    #output { height: 3; }
    .primary { background: green; color: black; }
    """

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        with Vertical():
            yield Input(placeholder="Type something", id="input")
            yield Button("Submit", id="submit", classes="primary")
            yield Static("", id="output")
        yield Footer()

    def on_button_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
        if event.button.id == "submit":
            text = self.query_one("#input", Input).value
            self.query_one("#output", Static).update(f"You typed: {text}")
